desc: Implement a compact code-only Python solution using the formula: p==2 -> all entries N%2; else s=(-1)^K, P=C^p via optimized binary exponentiation, V row/col for diagonal zeros and C[j][i] for off-diagonal zeros when p==3; output s*(P+V)%p.
Verify samples 1-3 and edge cases (N=1, all-zero, p=2, p=3, p>3, K parity) and fix any bugs.
